mapper.sql: result.id AS result_id, result.task_id, task.task_no, result.attempt_no, meter.id AS meter_id, meter.meter_no, meter.meter_name, meter.meter_type, meter.unit, result.reading_value, result.source_type, CASE result.source_type WHEN 'METER_READER' THEN result.meter_reader_id WHEN 'DEVICE' THEN result.device_id END AS executor_id, CASE result.source_type WHEN 'METER_READER' THEN reader.username WHEN 'DEVICE' THEN device.device_no END AS executor_code, CASE result.source_type WHEN 'METER_READER' THEN reader.display_name WHEN 'DEVICE' THEN device.device_name END AS executor_name, result.recognition_confidence, result.remark, result.review_status, task.task_status, result.version AS result_version, task.version AS task_version, result.submitted_at

FROM meter_reading_result AS result INNER JOIN meter_reading_task AS task ON task.id = result.task_id INNER JOIN meter ON meter.id = result.meter_id LEFT JOIN sys_user AS reader ON reader.id = result.meter_reader_id AND result.source_type = 'METER_READER' LEFT JOIN device ON device.id = result.device_id AND result.source_type = 'DEVICE'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM meter_reading_result WHERE id = #{resultId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT result.id FROM meter_reading_result AS result INNER JOIN meter_reading_task AS task ON task.id = result.task_id WHERE result.task_id = #{taskId} AND task.executor_type = 'METER_READER' AND task.meter_reader_id = #{meterReaderId} ORDER BY result.attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1
